pr_body:
Enable logsdb by default if `logsdb.prior_logs_usage` has not been set to true.

Meaning that if no data streams were created matching with the logs-*-* pattern in 8.x, then logsdb will be enabled by default for data streams matching with `logs-*-*` pattern.

Also removes `LogsPatternUsageService` as with version 9.0 and beyond, this component is no longer necessary.

Followup from #120708
Closes #106489

review_comment: I'm on the fence about deleting this, since `8.x` will continue to receive updates for a while - it's easier to have the same code in `8.x`, `9.x` and `main` as much as possible.. Maybe wrap this in a cluster setting with the default flipped in `9.x` and `main`?

This component should never be enabled in 9.0 and onwards. If it is accidentally enabled, then it can cause logsdb to not be enabled at all by default in 9.x. So I think it best just to delete this code.

I also think that the component itself shouldn't get any changes, except for bug fixes.
